description: The Legend rows Python's renderer draws by itself (gbdraw/legend/table.py::_generated_legend_fills) for some legend inputs, each with the palette key of its fill ('' when no palette key colors it, as for Depth). Python's answer is the keys, in order (tests/test_legend_row_facts.py); the Web app's is the palette key it reads from each key (services/specific-color-rules.js::generatedLegendRow), with every key a track row or a row of a present feature type (tests/web/specific-color-actions.test.mjs). The Web app leaves these rows out of a rule's rows (OV-307) and colors them from the palette live (candidate-render.js::draftLegendRowColors).
